set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

unit [parameter2] tunnel source [paramet.explanation: Configure the source interface for the tunnel interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: source-interface
parameters.explanation: Tunnel source interface name, e.g., g-0/0/1.

unit [parameter2] tunnel destination [pa.explanation: Configure the purpose address of the tunnel interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: destination-address
parameters.explanation: Tunnel destination address.

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: Autonomy system number for equipment, used for route agreements such as BGP.

set protocols bgp group [parameter1].explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

parameters.name: group
parameters.explanation: BGP Group name.

type [parameter2].explanation: Configure the type of BGP group to be external.

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: Type of BGP group, e.g. external.

neighbor [parameter2] peer-as [parameter.explanation: Configure BGP neighbours and their self-government systems.

parameters.name: neighbor-address
parameters.explanation: BGP neighbor's IP address.

parameters.name: peer-as
parameters.explanation: BGP Neighbors' Autonomy System Number.

local-address [parameter2].explanation: Configure the local address of the BGP group.

parameters.name: local-address
parameters.explanation: Local address of the BGP group.

family inet [parameter2].explanation: Configure the address of the BGP group as IPv4.

parameters.name: address-family
parameters.explanation: Address group type, e.g., inert unicast.

export [parameter2].explanation: Configure the BGP group export policy.

parameters.name: export-policy
parameters.explanation: Export the policy name.

set protocols ospf area [parameter1].explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

parameters.name: area
parameters.explanation: OSPF area ID.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g. g-2/0/0.

set policy-options policy-statement [par.explanation: This command fragment defines a routing policy named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing you to configure specific routing rules, actions, and conditions for traffic control.

parameters.name: policy-statement
parameters.explanation: name of the policy statement.

term [parameter2] from protocol [paramet.explanation: Configure the matching condition for the policy statement is the OSF protocol.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term of the policy statement.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.explanation: Matches the protocol type, for example, ospf.

term [parameter2] then [parameter3].explanation: Configure the action for the policy statement.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term of the policy statement.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Policy action, for example.
